violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw beef steak and raw fish stored over ready to eat food I walk in cooler, however, no actual cross contamination or evidence of cross contamination was observed.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: glass washing machine at bar had <50 ppm chlorine sanitizer concentration.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the kitchen rear was blocked at the start of the inspection, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. NOTE: Observed employee touching hair and face and returning to food preparation without washing hands.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. NOTE: Discussed with employee and CFM.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. NOTE: Observed employee washing hands in a prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. NOTE: Discussed with employee.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: All kitchenware and tableware washed in main dishmachine in kitchen and glass washer at bar.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: sushi rice.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Single service items were observed stored on the floor in the dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: No documentation provided on exhaust hood indicating when it was last serviced.
violations.corrective_action: Have the exhaust hood serviced immediately and as often as necessary to prevent the accumulation of oil and grease that could result in a fire, and have documentation posted on the hood which indicates the most recent date of service.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The dishmachine I the kitchen, and the glass washer at the bar both had chlorine sanitizer concentrations less than 10 ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Have the dishmachine and the glass washer serviced so that a chlorine sanitizer concentration of 50-200 ppm. Is achieved. All kitchenware and tableware must be sanitized in the three vat sink until the dishmachines are restored to fully functional condition.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: all fish obtained from True World (Note: Parasite destruction information information was provided for fish obtained from Komolo)
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine.

violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. The EHS instructed staff to use the designated hand sinks for hand washing. Preparation sink to be cleaned and sanitized.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the front preparation area being used to thaw pork and fill containers of garnishes with water.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS instructed staff to use food preparation sink for general food preparation purposes — designated hand sink only to be used for washing hands.

violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: salmon.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: salmon, tuna, yellowtail.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. The PIC wrote the consumer advisory onto the menus during the time of inspection.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter along the cook line and sushi bar.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. Wet cloths were placed into sanitizer buckets. ISSHO IZAKAYA AND SUSHI (Inspection Date: 11/21/2024) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no bleach test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
